title: The iris pocket watch
alt: An open gold pocket watch and its clasp are visible together on black velvet in a wider view.
description: Pull back from the close-up to reveal the chain while preserving the painted iris, hands and dial.
prompt: Pull the camera back for a square museum catalogue photograph on the same black velvet. Keep this exact open pocket watch, its gold case, iris-painted lid, two hands and unnumbered dial. Show its entire gold chain: attached to the bow, lying in a loose oval on the velvet above the watch, with a small clasp at the end. The watch, chain and clasp must all be inside the frame. Keep the same finely detailed close-up product photography and soft light. No text.

frames.label: Input
frames.alt: An antique gold pocket watch with a blue iris enamel lid.
frames.prompt: A complete antique pocket watch with its decorated lid opened to the left and connected by a visible hinge. The circular face has a ring of simple evenly spaced marks and two hands connected at the centre, without numerals. The lid contains a delicate enamel iris flower with indigo petals and green leaves on ivory. A fine gold chain attaches to the top loop and coils naturally on dark velvet. Precise goldwork, believable watch thickness, exquisite macro photograph, no lettering.
